poc_details: Hosted trial duration: 4 weeks (staging + limited prod).
Traffic: mix of interactive chat (70%), doc-search embeddings (20%), nightly rerank batch jobs (10%).
Observed avg QPS: 6 during daytime; 95th percentile peak QPS: 48 (short spikes around analytics reports).
Avg request token count (request+response): 420 tokens; token mix: 62% <128, 30% 128-512, 8% >512.
Measured latency (hosted baseline): p50=85ms token, p95=260ms token for assistant responses (varies by sequence length).
KV cache hit during trial: ~34% for repeated session prefixes; expected improvement after pinning prompt templates.
Result: product team satisfied with quality; main inhibitors are cost predictability and SLA for peak report windows.
dedicated_sizing_forecast: Summary: Using trial telemetry (4 weeks) we project monthly steady-state ~140M tokens with monthly peaks up to ~1.1B tokens during major analytics runs. Baseline avg QPS=6, 95th peak QPS=48, peak concurrent requests ~28–36 depending on session lengths. Token mix: 62% short (<128), 30% medium (128–512), 8% long (>512). Recommended Dedicated configuration: baseline 4x GPU nodes (A100/H100-equivalent) with autoscale policy to 8 nodes for scheduled nightly/all-company report spikes; enable KV prefix caching and batching window of 25–40ms to hit p95 latency target <200ms for assistant responses. Estimated monthly token throughput per 4-GPU baseline: ~140M tokens; with autoscale to 8 GPUs the platform can absorb peak bursts with p95 latency <300ms. Cost sensitivity buckets provided in attached sizing sheet (drive link). Conservatively estimate Dedicated breaks even on token spend vs Hosted at ~120M tokens/month given caching and quantization optimizations; benefits become material at >200M tokens/month and with predictable commit.
commercial_notes: Customer prefers a 3-month pilot (committed GPU-hours) then move to 12-month reserved if SLAs met. Negotiation points: price per committed GPU-hour, included traffic bursts, data egress, and extended log retention charges. Legal asked for a DPA and KMS appendix before committing.
